title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.28227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across

translated_title: 反馈捷径：面向潜在反馈Transformer的投机解码
translated_abstract: 将每个位置的顶层隐藏状态反馈到下一位置的输入中可以提升Transformer的性能。然而，这种反馈机制破坏了投机解码，因为验证一个草稿token需要其前一位置的顶层状态，这迫使草稿模型只能依赖一个近似的替代品。训练模型去适应这个替代品会降低精确解码的性能上限，而在推理时使用它又会引入近似误差。我们提出反馈捷径来解决这两个瓶颈。首先，状态对齐训练一个从多token预测头状态到替代品的轻量级投影，且完全不改动基础模型的训练。其次，流水线式修正利用前一位置新计算出的状态重新评估每个草稿，这是更接近真实反馈的代理。在后续草稿的验证过程中运行这种修正，可以在零额外调用的情况下提升准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出反馈捷径方法，通过状态对齐和流水线式修正两项技术，解决了潜在反馈Transformer与投机解码不兼容的问题，在不改动基础模型训练且不增加额外调用的情况下实现了准确的加速解码。
